proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ I m hI hm h
  have hI' : I ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hI
  have hp : I ^ m ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) := pow_mem hI' _
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff hI']
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff hp] at h
  have h1 : (ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨I, hI'⟩) ^ m = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow]; exact h
  have h2 : (ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨I, hI'⟩) ^ NumberField.classNumber K = 1 := by
    rw [NumberField.classNumber, pow_card_eq_one]
  exact orderOf_eq_one_iff.1 (Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hm (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h1) (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h2))
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (m : ℕ), I ≠ ⊥ → Nat.Coprime m (NumberField.classNumber K) → Submodule.IsPrincipal (I ^ m) → Submodule.IsPrincipal I
